content: Official WordPress Hosting/Core compatibility pages checked 2026-10-03 show WordPress 7.0 and 7.1 support PHP 7.4+, including PHP 8.3, 8.4 and 8.5; WordPress 7.0 raised the core minimum PHP to 7.4. The plugin selected floor is PHP 8.3. The release archive lists current WordPress 7.0 and 7.1 branch releases 7.0.6 and 7.1.2. Plugin Check and PHPUnit-based plugin integration validation complement each other; do not treat core compatibility as plugin compatibility.
